# 🧱 Never Push Too Much 🚫
`Git` `Code versioning` `Github`
<br /><br />
<img src="https://github.com/Toby16/system_engineering-devops/blob/8e2b2b0abff9ca6148f611771eede5d6505accaa/assets/never_push_too_much.jpg" alt="Never Push Too Much" width="600"/>

## Creating a .gitignore 🧹
* Here, we want to create a `.gitignore` file, and define a rulre to never push `~` files (usually generated by Emacs).<br />
  [Tips (gitignore docs)](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitignore).<br />
  *Let both branches have same contents in their .gitignore file.*<br />
  *We do this by editing update_script and merging with main (or master) branch* <br />

  ```
  /alx-zero_day$ git branch  # confirm you're on the 'update_script' branch
    master
  * update_script
  /alx-zero_day$ git checkout update_script  # only run this command if you find yourself in the master (or main) branch.
  /alx-zero_day$ echo "*~" >> 0x03-git/.gitignore  # defined a rule to never push ~ files
  /alx-zero_day$ git add .
  /alx-zero_day$ git commit -m "defined rule to never push emacs files"
  /alx-zero_day$ git push origin update_script  # commit and push your modified branch
  /alx-zero_day$
  /alx-zero_day$ git checkout master
  /alx-zero_day$ git merge --no-ff update_script
  /alx-zero_day$ git push 
  ```
<br />
`🏁 Done!`
